About

01

Dr. Prashant Kumar is an Assistant Professor at UPES, Dehradun, driving key initiatives in semiconductor technology and the newly introduced B.Tech program in VLSI Design and Technology. He earned his Ph.D. from the Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi, specialising in Organic Thin Film Transistors, and brings extensive teaching experience in VLSI and Analog Electronics from MITS Gwalior.

His expertise spans organic and flexible electronics, semiconductor device fabrication, TCAD simulation, and analog circuits for biomedical applications. Passionate about hands-on learning, Dr. Kumar integrates fabrication, modeling, and circuit design to foster innovation. He actively collaborates with industry to bridge the gap between academia and next-generation electronics.

🪷

Dr. Kumar's academic journey is deeply shaped by his mother's enduring belief in serving all with fairness and compassion, irrespective of background or bias. Her wisdom continues to guide him in creating an inclusive classroom where every student is seen, heard, and valued.

— A tribute to a mother's timeless teaching

"Let noble thoughts come to us from all directions." — Rig Veda (1.89.1)

Research Interests

02

Emerging Electronics

Organic & flexible electronics, low-power OFETs, eco-friendly device processing

Device Physics

Semiconductor fabrication, TCAD simulation (Silvaco), compact & physics-based modeling

Sensors & Optoelectronics

Gas sensors (NO₂, H₂S, NH₃), phototransistors, 2D material heterostructures

Analog VLSI

Preamplifiers for biomedical signal acquisition, low-power OTA design, RF CMOS
